statement.zh: 将锡拉喷发钉死在单一日历年——超出当前模型稳健性，留假说栏。
statement.en: Pinning the Thera eruption to a single calendar year exceeds current model robustness — keep as hypothesis.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Bayesian ranges are not unique calendar-year facts.
